Karakteristika te prones:
– Apartament 3+1
– Rruga Kongresi i Manastirit, pas UET
– Pallat i ri me ashensor
– Kati 4
– Siperfaqja Bruto 126.3m²
– Siperfaqja Neto 118.74m²
– Cmimi 219,000 Euro
Shitet apartament 3+1+Blk me siperfaqe totale 126.3m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor ne zonen e Porcelanit, pas Universitetit Europian te Tiranes.
Apartamenti organizohet ne korridor, sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete (njeri prej te cileve ne dhomen matrimoniale) dhe ballkoni.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar totalisht. Eshte i shtruar me parket, i pajisur me kondicioner, dritaret jane dopio xham.
Orientimi Lindje-Jug-Perendim.
Apartamenti ka super izolim te dyfishte, si nga jashte, ashtu dhe muret e brendshme me sistem kapot.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje zone e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, si linja urbani, shkolla, farmaci, markete, lokale, restorante etj.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe shitet dhe me kredi.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
description_en: Property characteristics: - Apartment 3+1 - Kongressi i Manastir street, behind UET - New building with elevator - Floor 4 - Gross area 126.3m² - Net area 118.74m² - Price 219,000 Euros 3+1+Blk apartment for sale with a total area of 126.3m², which is located on the 4th floor of a building new building with elevator in Porcelani area, behind the European University of Tirana. The apartment is organized in a corridor, a living room, a kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (one of which is in the master bedroom) and a balcony. The apartment is sold fully furnished. It is laid with parquet, equipped with air conditioning, the windows are double glazed. Orientation East-South-West. The apartment has super double insulation, both from the outside, as well as the internal walls with the kapot system. The apartment is located in an area that offers all the necessary facilities, such as city lines, schools, pharmacies, markets, bars, restaurants, etc. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and is sold with credit. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
